text:
Maria G.: quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today

Maria G.: done: landed KV prefetch heuristic (PR #4128). Reduced cold-start median by ~18% in local benchmark.
Maria G.: blocker: seeing a handful of OOMs on 8k sequence runs when prefetch + microbatching enabled together. repro steps attached below.

Dave: nice! can you paste the microbatch config you used? wondering if batch size/simd combo is making mem spike.

Maria G.: config snippet: 
```json
{"microbatch_size": 4, "max_tokens": 2048, "kv_prefetch": true, "cache_shard":"auto"}
```

Kai: fyi I hit similar OOMs yesterday with 3-4x concatenated prompts; looks like our KV allocation doesn't trim stale entries during prefetch.

Sasha: quick idea — limit prefetch window when seq_len > 4k and fall back to on-demand. That should avoid the allocation surge.

Nate: @Maria G. can you run the repro with this env var: `RUNTIME_PREFETCH_LIMIT=2` and post the `dmesg` + `runtime.log`? I suspect we can hotspot the growth.

Maria G.: running now. attaching tail of runtime.log that shows the spike starting when a batch hits prefix 6:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z INFO kv: prefetch: keys=96 bytes=1.2GB
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z WARN mem: nearing limit: reserved=11.8GB total=12.0GB
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z ERROR oom: allocation failed allocating 256MB
```

Iris: thanks — that matches the hypothesis. For a short-term mitigation we can add an admission check: if estimated_prefetch_bytes + current_reserved > target_margin then skip prefetch for that request.

Kai: agree. also want to flag that microbatching math uses the worst-case token estimate; we could switch to p50 estimate for latency-sensitive paths. low risk but might increase cold cost.

Sasha: for rollout plan: patch to add admission check + env toggle, run canary on dedicated pool with heavy long-seq traces, monitor OOMs and tail latency.

Maria G.: putting up PR shortly (will tag @Kai and @Sasha). PR includes an opt-in env: `KV_PREFETCH_ADMISSION=enabled` and a feature flag to use p50 estimate.

Dave: pinged you on the CR. left two small comments (nits + a logging line). looks safe to canary once CI is green. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/dedicated-pool -> will run after CI (job: build/bench/kv-prefetch). ETA ~12m.

Nate: tiny ask — can someone add a bench-case that exercises 6k+ sequences with microbatch=3? we don't have that in our perf matrix.

Maria G.: adding bench case now. command I used locally: `./tools/bench --model rose-13b --seq 6144 --microbatch 4 --iters 30`

Iris: if canary looks good, let's schedule a short follow-up sync tomorrow to decide whether p50 makes sense by default.

Maria G.: sounds good. thanks everyone — will post PR link and canary results here once CI finishes.

Kai: TL;DR: landed prefetch heuristic great gains, OOM on long seq + microbatch, admission control + p50 estimate proposed, canary queued.

Sasha: optional: add a metric `kv_prefetch_skipped` so we can measure how often admission check fires during canary.

Maria G.: good call — adding metric to PR.

Dave: thanks, and if canary is stable let's include note in release blurb to ops about the new env toggles.

Maria G.: will do.
